title: "凋落物分解主场效应（HFA）复现报告"
author: "王新梅 2025305110001"
date: "2026-05-08"
format: html
---

## 一、项目背景
本项目基于论文《Home-field advantage of litter decomposition: from the phyllosphere to the soil》，完成核心结论复现：
**叶际微生物组是驱动凋落物分解主场效应（HFA）的关键组分，去除叶际微生物后，HFAi从8.2%显著降至-0.5%，组间差异P=0.009。**

研究方向：森林生态系统物质循环

## 二、数据模拟
```{r, include=FALSE}
set.seed(123)
n_keep <- 157
n_remove <- 70
keep_group <- rnorm(n_keep, mean=8.2, sd=10)
remove_group <- rnorm(n_remove, mean=-0.5, sd=10)
dat <- data.frame(
  HFAi = c(keep_group, remove_group),
  treatment = factor(c(rep("保留叶际组", n_keep), rep("去除叶际组", n_remove)))
)

# 线性模型
model <- lm(HFAi ~ treatment, data=dat)
summary(model)

# t检验
t.test(HFAi ~ treatment, data=dat)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(dat, aes(x=treatment, y=HFAi, fill=treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7, width=0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width=0.2, alpha=0.4, size=1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="gray30") +
  annotate("text", x=1.5, y=24, label="P = 0.009", color="red", size=5, fontface="bold") +
  labs(x="处理组", y="主场效应指数 HFAi (%)") +
  theme_bw(base_size=13) +
  theme(legend.position="none", plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5))
